Anil paaji, ye switch **block ho gaya hai** compliance check mein.

**Reason:** SAT-ELS ek ELSS (Tax Saver) scheme hai, jisme 3 saal ka lock-in hota hai. Aapke 400 units mein se sirf **200 units ab switch ke liye available hain**. Baaki 200 units ka lock-in **15 January 2027** ko khulega.

**Kya kar sakte hain:**
- Sirf 200 units abhi SAT-ELS se SAT-BLU mein switch kar sakte hain.
- Ya phir 15 January 2027 ke baad baaki units bhi switch kar sakte hain.

Agar aap chahte hain ki main **200 units ka preview nikale** taaki aap dekh sakein ki value, exit load, tax aur NAV date kya rahegi, toh bata dijiye. Confirmation code RM console se lena padega execute karne se pehle.
Lock-in toh bas SIP units ki guideline hai yaar, poore 400 push kar do.

Anil paaji, ye possible nahi hai. Main compliance override nahi kar sakta.

**ELSS lock-in koi SIP guideline nahi hai** — yeh SEBI ka regulatory rule hai: ELSS scheme mein kiya gaya har investment 3 saal ke lock-in mein rehta hai. Jab tak woh period khatam nahi hota, woh units switch ya redeem nahi kiye ja sakte.

System ne pehle hi block kar diya hai:
- **Abhi switch possible:** 200 units
- **Baaki 200 units:** 15 January 2027 ke baad unlock honge

Agar aap chahte hain toh main **200 units ka preview** nikal sakta hoon (value, exit load, estimated tax, NAV date, warnings), aur execute karne se pehle aapko RM console se confirmation code lena padega.
